title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：migration　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 migration 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the keeper ① made the migration that no child in the zoo would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the season. The ② migration, meaning the journey itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a migration, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ migration in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ migration at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A migration, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the keeper said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the migration was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the journey. The ⑥ migration, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; migration, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a journey and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ migration had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ migration of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of describing; migration, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ migration I remember is the journey described in the register, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ migration, my mother said in 1983, is the only journey that improves by being described; every migration, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a journey. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 迁徙；移居（指兽舍里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 迁徙；移居（指那次迁徙本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the migration 完成这一次迁徙
D. n. 迁徙；移居（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 迁徙之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的迁徙之事）
F. n. 迁徙；移居（指饲养台账里写到、被描述的那一次）
G. n. 迁徙、变迁（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 变迁（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the migration that no child in the zoo would have described
The migration, meaning the journey itself and not the fence
the migration at the far shed
the migration was the whole of the matter
the migration had become a line in a register
The migration of the whole thing
A migration, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: make the migration 意为“完成这一次迁徙”，1974 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯描述的一次迁徙做了一遍。
migration 意为“迁徙；移居”，指那次迁徙本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。
migration 意为“迁徙；移居”，指兽舍里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
migration 意为“迁徙；移居”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
migration 意为“迁徙、变迁”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次变迁就是那件事的全部。
migration 意为“变迁”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次迁徙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
migration 意为“迁徙；移居”，指饲养台账里写到、被描述的那一次，到 1979 年这一次成了饲养台账里的一行。
migration 意为“迁徙之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的迁徙之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的描述。
migration 意为“迁徙；移居”，我记得的是饲养台账里描述过的那一次，1981 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一次。
migration 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，迁徙是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的迁徙。
